foundation.framingA.title: This is our first meeting.
foundation.framingA.body:
Seven quiet questions — but you can stop after three and see your first reading.

No right answers. Honest beats impressive.

This isn't a test. It's a first photograph of where you are right now, so I can meet you there.
foundation.framingB.title: This is your foundation.
foundation.framingB.body:
What you just gave me becomes your starting band.

Over the next days I'll keep recalibrating — this isn't a test, it's a first photograph.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Skip ahead — show my reading now
foundation.q1.title: Which of these patterns runs loud in you right now?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Up to 3. Be honest.
foundation.q1.opt1: Not enough — I'm not doing enough
foundation.q1.opt2: Control — if I let go, it all falls apart
foundation.q1.opt4: Worry — same fear, same story, same knot
foundation.q1.opt6: Identity — 'who am I really?' won't leave
foundation.q2.title: What practice tempo can you actually sustain right now?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Not aspiration. What your current life will actually give.
foundation.q2.opt1: Gentle — one small ritual, sustainable forever
foundation.q2.opt3: Fierce — I want tapas, I want it to burn
foundation.q2.opt4: Monastic — I want most of the day inside this
foundation.q3.title: When you daydream about your best self, they are...
foundation.q3.opt2: In love — dissolved into something larger
foundation.q3.opt4: Wise — quiet, clear, others come to them
foundation.q3.opt5: Between worlds — seeing what others can't
foundation.q3.opt6: A quiet presence people heal near
foundation.q3.opt8: Making something the world hasn't seen
foundation.q3.opt9: Holding a house / kingdom / team well
foundation.q4.title: Which doorway is closest to you right now?
foundation.q4.opt6: Energy work — breath, inner technique, aliveness
foundation.q5.title: What are you here to rethink?
foundation.q5.opt1: A belief I've carried since childhood
foundation.q5.opt3: My relationship with work and effort
foundation.q5.opt5: What I allow myself to feel
foundation.q6.title: Which feels most true?
foundation.q6.opt2: I have some choice in how I respond
foundation.q7.title: When something hard happens, where do you go first?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Notice the very first move.
foundation.q7.opt1: Into my head — analyze, plan, replay
foundation.q7.opt2: Into my heart — feel, reach for someone
foundation.q7.opt3: Into action — move, fix, do something
foundation.q8.title: How familiar are you with watching your own thoughts?
foundation.q8.opt4: It's a steady part of my life
foundation.analysis.subtitle: This will shift as you practice. None of it is fixed — that's the whole point.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: We'll re-read this every few days. Bands move. That's the whole point.
foundation.brain.head.label: Head-led
foundation.brain.heart.label: Heart-led
foundation.brain.gut.label: Gut-led
foundation.brain.head.line: You think first. We'll honour that, then teach the body to catch up.
foundation.brain.heart.line: You feel first. We'll keep that open, and add a witness behind it.
foundation.brain.gut.line: You move first. We'll slow you just enough to hear what's underneath.
foundation.analysis.loopsEmpty: Nothing loud yet — we'll find them in the doing.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: You can always return to your reading later from Settings. Nothing is final.
foundation.paths.title: Choose your companions.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Observation is the ground — every road starts there. Pick 2–3 paths that feel most alive to you right now. You can always add more later.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Watching what is, without grabbing or pushing. Every road we walk together starts from this seat.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: This is your starting point — not a cage. Your path will evolve as you do.

foundation.path.karma.blurb: Action without attachment. Service as prayer.
foundation.path.jnana.blurb: Inquiry. Cutting through illusion with clarity.
foundation.path.tantra.blurb: Everything is sacred. Nothing is excluded.
